Chapter 991: Chapter 8: A Test of a Cosmic Era, You Understood in One Year? (Subscribe Requested)

Handing over all twelve-layer weapons, treasures, and rarities, for the many ultimate beings of the twelfth layer, is a price too unbearable.

The likelihood of surviving the cosmic cataclysm would drastically decrease.

But without handing them over, there wouldn’t even be a chance to endure the cosmic cataclysm.

How to choose, the many ultimate beings of the twelfth layer are naturally clear in their hearts.

In fact, during the period of being suppressed in the palace, many of the twelfth layer’s ultimate beings were already very dissatisfied.

If they had agreed to the Galaxy Master’s terms initially, handed over ninety percent of the twelfth layer weapons, treasures, and rarities, and submitted to human civilization, all would be well.

Yet some of the twelfth layer’s ultimate beings were unwilling, wanting to revolt.

Revolt?

What would the result be?

Therefore.

When faced with Lin Yuan’s new conditions, not a single twelfth layer’s ultimate being dared to hesitate.

“Hand them over first.”

Lin Yuan spoke up.

At this moment, the several dozen twelfth layer ultimate beings within the palace were nothing more than chicken ribs to Lin Yuan.

The arrival of the cosmic cataclysm; if Lin Yuan continued to carry the palace and the several dozen twelfth layer ultimate beings with him, he would face the backlash and suppression of a vast majority of the cosmic origin source.

It’s equivalent to Lin Yuan helping the several dozen twelfth layer ultimate beings to withstand the cosmic cataclysm.

“Hand them over first?”

Inside the palace, the several dozen twelfth layer ultimate beings hesitated slightly.

To hand over the treasures and rarities first, what if the Galaxy’s strongest beings back out later and don’t let them go?

“I trust the Galaxy’s strongest beings.”

A twelfth layer ultimate being from the Star Alliance thought for a moment and resolutely took out all the treasures and rarities.

Now, they don’t have the capital to negotiate with the Galaxy’s strongest beings; he even felt that being given the chance to be released by the Galaxy’s strongest beings was a grace.

“Out you go.”

Lin Yuan collected the treasures and rarities and immediately transported the ultimate being from the Star Alliance out.

“Thank you, Galaxy’s strongest being.”

The Star Alliance’s ultimate being ecstatically said, thanking repeatedly before his figure disappeared instantly.

In the palace, one by one, the twelfth layer ultimate beings, seeing this, immediately offered up all their treasures and rarities, and then they were transported out, one by one.

“Remember, the universe now is the territory of human civilization,” Lin Yuan rarely reminded.

“Rest assured, Galaxy’s strongest being, we definitely will not violate the rules of human civilization,” numerous twelfth layer ultimate beings hastily said.

Violate the rules?

The Galaxy Master could suppress them once, and he could suppress them twice, three times.

Watching one by one as the twelfth layer ultimate beings disappeared, Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm.

These twelfth layer ultimate beings, having lost their weapons and treasures, the chance of surviving the cosmic cataclysm is probably only twenty to thirty percent.

And even if they do survive, if they dare show any malice.

Lin Yuan still has dozens of incarnations, waiting outside the universe.

Compared to inside the universe, those twelfth layer ultimate beings are facing Lin Yuan, who is greatly suppressed by the cosmic origin source in every aspect.

Outside the universe, even just one incarnation, the means deployed far exceed those inside the universe, that’s when true despair sets in.

“These weapons, treasures, and rarities…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the items offered by the dozens of twelve-tier ultimate beings and slightly nodded.

All the weapons, arms, treasures, and rare items together were worth close to one hundred thousand Chaos Stones, equivalent to the fortune of a normal sovereign realm powerhouse.

At the Thousand Treasures Convention on Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, Lin Yuan had spent thirty thousand Chaos Stones to buy that golden box, now it seemed he had recouped his investment.

“Chaos Void…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound.

After the great annihilation of the universe, what the human civilization needed to do was to find a new homeland in the Chaos Void as quickly as possible, then establish and develop there.

As for continuing to live in the internal universe? The internal universe cannot breed true powerhouses, no matter from the Origin Source, the internal universe is far inferior to the real cosmic starry skies, let alone the Chaos Void?

Up to now, any twelve-tier life in the universe, whether special life or clan life, all originated from within the universe, as for the internal universe? Its limit has been directly defined.

“With the current foundation of human civilization, it should be no problem to buy a piece of continental fragment next to Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The new homeland of human civilization naturally emphasizes safety, and the nearby large area is naturally the safest around Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

The volume of Ancient Ming Chaos Continent is equivalent to tens of universes, and naturally, there are some continental fragments surrounding it.

Equivalent to a part of Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, even if Ancient Ming Chaos Continent moves and sets sail, it will carry the surrounding fragments with it.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong, the couple, were full of worries, Lin Yi also stood obediently to the side.

“Xiaoyuan, what exactly is going on now, why have many citizens of Canglan Star started to migrate?”

Lu Qiong asked in a low voice.

“Yes, migrate? To where?”

Lin Shoucheng couldn’t help asking.

According to the plan devised by Xuanyuan Supreme and the other nine supremes, only about one percent of all citizens of the human civilization would be able to be moved into the internal universe.

And Canglan Star… because of Lin Yuan, all citizens of Canglan Star were able to obtain migration rights.

“Moving to another universe.”

Lin Yuan simply said.

In order to prevent the citizens from reacting too violently, Xuanyuan Supreme along with other nine supremes, had not disclosed the reason for the migration.

After all, the great annihilation of the universe was truly unimaginable.

“Why move to another universe?”

Lu Qiong was still puzzled.

“Don’t talk about this matter externally.” Lin Yuan looked at his parents, under his protection, his parents would definitely survive safely.

Not only his parents, relatives, but even the entire Canglan Star, Chikun Star Domain, had their fierce competition reduced or even avoided under Lin Yuan’s influence.

“This universe is about to be destroyed.” Lin Yuan said.

“The universe is about to be destroyed?” Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong were a bit baffled.

In their eyes, the universe was vast and endless, even if it had a day of destruction, it seemed incredibly distant.

“Due to external influences on the universe, I will send you into my universe in a while, where life on Canglan Star won’t be much different.”

Lin Yuan said.

His internal universe currently has almost reached eight million light-years in radius, for the vast majority of citizens of human civilization, eight million light-years and the complete cosmic starry skies wouldn’t make much difference.

“Brother, the universe is being destroyed, can even you not prevent it?” Lin Yi quietly said from the side.

She had previously obtained some information about the demise of the universe from the Xia Family, hearing Lin Yuan personally pronounce it, although shocked, she quickly recovered.

“Unable to stop.” Lin Yuan fell silent for a moment, shaking his head as he spoke.

Now, he seemed too insignificant before the two Chaos Great Saints.

Not only him, but Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint, having battled all this way, countless cosmos collapsed and perished prematurely because of it.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Inside the jade gourd.

Lin Yuan looked serious, reaching for a rune and carefully examining it in front of him.

Originally, facing the massive destruction of the universe, 99% of human civilization was doomed to die, but these 3,333 runes gave Lin Yuan hope.

Merging all the runes’ cosmic structural advantages, it could not only allow more human citizens to survive, but it also had an unimaginable boosting effect on Lin Yuan’s strength.

Peak of Path Splitting Realm, possessing a universe within the body close to Chaos Realm?

What does that imply?

Not to mention being comparable to Chaos Venerables, at the very least it must be an invincible presence in the Master Realm, right?

“Cosmic structure…”

Lin Yuan immersed his entire mind into it, at that moment, he no longer perceived the rules, even putting aside the complete refining of Martial Tao’s control chapter, focusing all his efforts on understanding the complex runes before him.

[Your comprehension defies nature, observing the mystical runes, significantly enhancing your understanding of the cosmic structure…]

New insights continuously burst forth in Lin Yuan’s mind, a complete model of cosmic structure emerged within his mind.

Quickly refined, swiftly formed.

…

Not far away.

A girl in red was lying bored next to a giant rock, legs crossed, glancing at Lin Yuan.

“So boring, I really want to talk to someone.”

The girl in red felt troubled, as she truly wished Lin Yuan could spare time from interpreting runes to chat with her.

But she also knew that would hinder the progress of comprehension, interpreting these 3,333 runes within a cosmic era is undeniably arduous.

“Just endure it.”

“Better not to disturb him.”

After some inner conflict, the girl in red decided against seeking Lin Yuan for a chat.

What if she caused Lin Yuan to fail, continuing to be trapped in this place for endless years?

“The first rune is the simplest of all, normally speaking, it would take about ten million years to interpret it.”

The girl in red looked at Lin Yuan and the floating rune in front of him, thinking to herself.

However, the next moment.

Under the gaze of the girl in red, the rune in front of Lin Yuan slowly dissipated.

“Huh?”

The girl in red was stunned. The rune dissolved?

These runes left by her old master could only dissolve when fully comprehended.

Fully comprehended?

Did Lin Yuan comprehend the first rune?

The girl in red suddenly realized it, her expression incredulous.

How long has it been? He figured out the first rune already?

The girl in red found it hard to believe.

“It must be a coincidence.”

“Perhaps the universe of his homeland has a similar cosmic structure.”

Thinking quickly, although the 3,333 runes were created by the owner of the jade gourd.

Among the countless universes bred in the Chaos Void, it’s inevitable that similar structured universes exist.

If Lin Yuan happened to be born in such a universe, quickly comprehending the first rune could be somewhat explained.

The girl in red continued to watch Lin Yuan.

An hour later.

The second rune disappeared.

The girl in red fell silent.

Could it be Lin Yuan’s luck was so good, encountering two similar universe structured runes?

Two hours later.

The third rune disappeared.

Five hours later.

The fourth rune disappeared.

…

One day later.

The fifty-eighth rune disappeared.

…

One month later.

The three hundred sixty-second rune disappeared.

…..

Half a year later.

The two thousandth rune disappeared.

…..

One year later.

The three thousand three hundredth rune disappeared.

…

Since Lin Yuan quickly comprehended the first rune, the girl in red had shifted from leaning against a giant rock to sitting and then standing, watching him with utmost seriousness.

She watched as each rune quickly disappeared.

Initially scattered throughout the heavens and earth, thousands of runes were now almost all gone.

Only a few dozen lonely runes were left floating around.

“One year.”

The girl in red calculated the time.

Given Lin Yuan’s efficiency in comprehending runes, the remaining few dozen might not take much longer.

That means.

The original standard set by the jade gourd’s master was a cosmic era, but Lin Yuan cracked it in just one year?
